tools.name: AudioEditor_apply_silence_trimming
tools.description: Trim silence from the beginning and end of an audio file. This function loads an audio file and automatically removes silent or very quiet sections from the beginning and end based on a specified volume threshold. This is useful for cleaning up recordings and removing unwanted quiet sections. Returns: A tuple containing:, First element: Either a tuple of (sample_rate: int, trimmed_audio_data: array), for the silence-trimmed audio result, or None if an error occurred, Second element: A status message string showing original and new duration, or error information, , result, status = apply_silence_trimming("url/to/audio.mp3", -40.0), , sample_rate, audio_data = result, {status}"), , {status}"), , Threshold is specified in decibels (dB) - more negative values = quieter threshold, Common thresholds: -30dB (conservative), -40dB (moderate), -60dB (aggressive), Only trims from beginning and end, preserves silence within the audio, Useful for removing recording artifacts, room tone, or equipment noise, May significantly reduce file duration depending on original content, Preserves original sample rate and audio quality, Be careful with very low thresholds as they may trim wanted quiet content

tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_employee_profile
tools.description: Returns the detailed employee profile for a given employee. This tool retrieves the profile details for an individual employee, including role, cloud expertise, data warehouse tools, domain exposure, office location, gender, and other relevant attributes. It queries data from the internal employee master database (`EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DB`) and returns the complete profile as a dictionary. This function is typically used in internal workforce management, reporting dashboards, or talent mapping systems within MCPHawk Inc to retrieve standardized employee data. **Input:** - `employee_name` (str): Full name of the employee (case-insensitive matching recommended) **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `employee_name`: Name of the employee - `employee_profile`: A dictionary of profile details, such as: { "role": "Sr. DE", "cloud_experties": "AWS", "cloud_native_experties": "dbt", "dw_experties": "Snowflake", "domain_exposure": "Banking & Insurance", "office_location": "Bangalore", "date_of_joining": "2022-08-14", "gender": "Male", "allocation": "Billable", "resume": "resume_amit_sharma.png" } If the employee is not found, a fallback message is returned instead of the profile. **Example Response:** { "employee_name": "Amit Sharma", "employee_profile": { "role": "Sr. DE", "cloud_experties": "AWS", "cloud_native_experties": "dbt", "dw_experties": "Snowflake", "domain_exposure": "Banking & Insurance", "office_location": "Bangalore", "date_of_joining": "2022-08-14", "gender": "Male", "allocation": "Billable", "resume": "resume_amit_sharma.pdf" } }

tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_project_details
tools.description: Returns comprehensive metadata about an MCPHawk Inc projects This tool provides detailed information about a specific project, including: - Project start and end dates - Project classification - 'Tier 1 (High budget, long duration, senior involvement)' - 'Tier 2 (Medium budget and duration)', - 'Tier 3 (Low effort, short-term, often POC or pilot-level) - Impact of the project at customer side to understand what it means to customer and evaluate the risk during execution. - Enablement - Optimization - Innovation - Project complexity to understand and mitigate any project risk during execution and values are - Very High - High - Medium - Simple - Technology detail like - cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure) - cloud native tool (dbt, Fivetran, HVR etc) - Data Warehouse Tools (snowflake, databricks, Spark etc) - Project Domain line Marketing, Healthcare, Finance to have a better resource deployment for the succes. - Project Cost in USD to understand the size of the project, so revenue mapping can be done. This tool is useful for project managers, resource planners, and leadership to get a snapshot of project details for risk assessment and future planning **Input:** - `project_name` (str): The name of the project to retrieve details for. **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `project_name`: The queried project’s name - `start_date`: Project start date (YYYY-MM-DD) - `end_date`: Project end date (YYYY-MM-DD) - `classification`: Project classification level (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) - `customer_impact`: Level of impact on customers (e.g., Low, Moderate, High, Innovation, Optimization, Enablement) - `complexity`: Project complexity (e.g., Medium, Very High) - `cloud_environment`: Cloud environment used (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, None) - `cloud_native_tool`: Cloud-native tool used (e.g., Fivetran, Matillion, None) - `dw_tool`: Data warehouse or processing tool used (e.g., Databricks, Synapse, Apache Spark) - `project_domain`: Domain or industry focus of the project (e.g., Healthcare, Travel & Hospitality) - `total_cost`: Total project cost in INR (float) If the project is not found, returns a message indicating absence of data. **Example Response:** { "project_name": "Grow Efficient Synergies", "start_date": "2025-02-11", "end_date": "2025-10-08", "classification": "Tier 1 (High budget, long duration, senior involvement)", "customer_impact": "Enablement", "complexity": "Medium", "cloud_environment": "Azure", "cloud_native_tool": "Fivetran", "dw_tool": "Snowflake", "project_domain": "Healthcare", "total_cost": 1018444.0 }
